newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: New tremor shakes eastern Venezuela area.
newsitem.headline: New tremor shakes eastern Venezuela area.

text.p: A tremor on Wednesday shook an area of eastern Venezuela that was hit by a powerful earthquake three weeks ago that killed 81 people, the Civil Defence said.

The new quake, measuring 4.4 on the open-ended Richter scale, caused panic among people in the small city of Casanay, in Sucre state, but there were no immediate reports of victims or damage, Civil Defence chief Angel Freitas told Reuters.

Venezuela's deadliest quake in three decades, measuring 6.9 on the Richter scale, struck on July 9 in the neighbouring town of Cariaco, toppling buildings and crushing dozens of children as they took end-of-term exams.
The Venezuelan Seismological Institute said Wednesday's quake struck at 10:06 a.m. (1406 GMT) and its epicentre was in Casanay.
